external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and may connect a partner app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A member's browser used to sign in and approve partner app consent.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: Authorization server that signs members in, issues authorization codes, refresh tokens and access tokens, and handles partner consent.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: API that reads and writes the points ledger and processes gift-card redemptions.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: partner app
processes.description: A web application operated by another company that can show a member's points.
processes.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: support console
processes.description: Web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Member signs in through the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.description: Member approves the partner app consent screen and listed scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: approves a consent screen that lists the scopes

data_flows.name: authorization-code-flow
data_flows.description: Mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: PKCE challenge status was not recorded.

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: Mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: Partner app sends token requests containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: client ID, client secret and token request

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: Authorization server returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The source describes the browser returning to the redirect URI; the authorization server is the issuer of the authorization code.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: Partner app requests a member's points from the rewards API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: manage identity data
data_flows.description: Authorization server stores and accesses member identity and authorization data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents

data_flows.name: read-write points
data_flows.description: Rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: Rewards API writes received requests and headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: Support console marks a member account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's own cloud account, where the authorization server, rewards API, support console and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: A member's phone, outside the organisation's cloud account, where the mobile app runs.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies where partner apps run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is reachable from the internet because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is reachable from the internet because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
